title: 不支持思考的 Gemini 模型请求不应包含 `includeThoughts`

### 已测试多数推理模型，包括 Gemini、Claude3、Qwen3，一切正常。

- fix #7985

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This is an agent issue because it involves incompatible parameters (`includeThoughts`) being passed to LLM providers (Gemini and VertexAI), which falls under the sub-category "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" in the taxonomy.
